summary: Iteration 9 validates the four Jack07 fixes + the regular TV channel playback restoration. Backend pytest: 6/6 pass. Frontend Playwright end-to-end: upcoming Football match cards no longer expose any score block (0 cards with score among 37 scheduled cards visible), live cards correctly show '▶ X sources disponibles' OR '✕ Aucune source pour le moment', scheduled cards show '▶ Sources au coup d'envoi' — no generic 'Sources multi-serveurs' anywhere. Click on the live match 4330229 (2 sources) opens AdUnlockModal → step1 → step2 → Jack07Overlay with [data-testid='jack07-sources-count']='2 sources'. Browser DOES make the client-side GET to https://apis-data10.tcore131ybdf.ru/api/stream/detail?streamId=729424&siteType=2001&matchId=4330229&sportType=1 (HTTP 200). The subsequent hls.js fetch to fhlsport723.tm3ubp4r5mk1strange.ru/.../index.m3u8 is blocked by CORS in the browser (documented upstream limitation) — the 3-second auto-fallback then flips the overlay into iframe mode (jack07-iframe-wrap visible, jack07-toggle-mode 'Revenir au lecteur direct (natif)' visible, NO 'Flux indisponible' error rendered). The embedded iframe loads the Jack07 native site player so the user can actually watch. Regular TV channels: /api/channels + /api/stream/{id} returns a valid HLS manifest with body starting '#EXTM3U' and content-type application/vnd.apple.mpegurl; backend logs confirm GET https://apis.wavewatch.top/deltawatch.php?action=resolve + ?action=hls_manifest both return 200 (DELTAWATCH_URL + STREAM_SECRET env vars correctly loaded).

integration_issues.issue: Documented upstream limitation — the segment edge host fhlsport*.tm3ubp4r5mk1strange.ru returns CORS-blocked / ERR_FAILED for browser XHR. The api/stream/detail handshake itself succeeds (200) and yields a valid manifest URL+token, but the segments cannot be played by hls.js in the browser. Auto-fallback to iframe handles this gracefully (3s timer). Not a regression — accepted end-state per problem statement.

rca of the issue: User-reported bugs and the verified fixes: (1) 'Ekibastuzets 1-1 FK Arys' score on a scheduled card — root cause: upstream protobuf field 100 carries the score block from the PREVIOUS fixture between the same teams even when status=scheduled. Fix: _project_match now gates scores on status_kind in ('live','finished'), returning None otherwise. Verified 0 scheduled cards expose a score. (2) Direct playback failed with 'Connexion au flux…' — root cause: backend resolves the manifest fine but the segment edge CDN (streamas16.pha5102cdga.xyz / fhlsport*.tm3ubp4r5mk1strange.ru) geo-blocks our backend IP and CORS-rejects browser XHR alike. Fix: stop server-side proxying for Jack07 streams; instead return `api_url` so the browser performs the AES-CBC+ROT47+protobuf walk directly (where the user's IP is more likely accepted by the CDN). When CORS still blocks (CI/headless networks), a 3s auto-fallback rotates the overlay into iframe mode where the upstream site's own player (different origin, different CDN rules) plays. (3) Match cards needed source counts — added /api/jack07/stream-counts bulk endpoint backed by the 30s detail cache; UI calls it once per visible page of LIVE matches and renders 'X sources disponibles' / 'Aucune source pour le moment' / 'Sources au coup d'envoi'. (4) Auto-fallback — Jack07Overlay starts a 3s timer on mount that flips to iframe if no source resolves; verified the iframe was visible within ~3.7s of clicking the live card. (5) TV channels broken — DELTAWATCH_URL and STREAM_SECRET were missing from /app/backend/.env; restored, backend logs now show deltawatch.php?action=resolve + action=hls_manifest 200, /api/stream/{id} returns a proxy_url whose body is real HLS.
